criteria.name: Completeness and coverage
criteria.description: Whether all material parts of the request are addressed.
positive_signals: does not omit a required deliverable
criteria.overlap_review: Near-duplicate of Task fulfillment; excluded from the active whitelist.

criteria.name: Instruction and constraint adherence
criteria.description: Whether explicit instructions and constraints are followed.
positive_signals: uses the requested form when material
criteria.overlap_review: Already explicit in Task fulfillment; excluded from the active whitelist.

criteria.name: Actionability and practical utility
criteria.description: When the request calls for action, whether the response gives feasible information the user can apply.
positive_signals: offers feasible next actions when requested
criteria.overlap_review: Complements Task fulfillment for advice and planning; conditional wording avoids requiring action steps for every task.

criteria.name: Appropriate level of detail
criteria.description: Whether the amount of detail is proportionate to the request and its practical stakes.
positive_signals: is concise when the task is simple
negative_signals: adds detail that obscures the answer
criteria.overlap_review: Partly overlaps Clarity and relevance, but isolates response granularity rather than organization or topical focus.

criteria.name: Uncertainty and limitation handling
criteria.description: When uncertainty or material limitations exist, whether they are represented proportionately and without fabrication.
criteria.overlap_review: Related to Correctness, but concerns calibration of epistemic status rather than factual accuracy alone.

criteria.name: Supporting justification when relevant
criteria.description: When a conclusion or recommendation needs support, whether sufficient reasoning or evidence is supplied.
negative_signals: asserts a consequential conclusion without support
uses reasoning unrelated to the conclusion
criteria.overlap_review: Related to Correctness; retained only for cases where inspectable support is needed, not as a universal verbosity requirement.
